A.note: Strong points: 12 slides with concrete numbers that agree across slides, including participation, satisfaction, budget execution, before/after comparisons, student quotes, a standout example and the 2027 plan, shown with varied charts, KPI cards and an org chart. Weak points: the tables on slides 6, 9 and 10 use very small text that is hard to read on screen, and slide 10 is a small table above a mostly empty area.

B.note: Strong points: it follows the familiar city-hall report format, with a table of contents and numbered sections, and the large text with clear key-message bars reads easily. Weak points: it has less data and depth, with only one chart and fewer details than A. The design is a single navy colour throughout and feels plain, slide 8 leaves a lot of empty space, and the thank-you slide adds no information.
